# Edges

::: warning Preview version
The jsMind V2 programming API is currently a preview. The API will change in later updates. Please check this documentation anytime for the interface that is current.
:::

Additional relationships between nodes. Parent-child structure is not represented as an edge.

This page is generated from the published typings `dist/jsmind.d.ts` with TypeDoc.

## JmEdge {#JmEdge}

*Class*

Edge of mind map.

**Remarks**

Edges represent additional relationships between nodes (not parent-child relationships).

### Constructor {#JmEdge.constructor}

```ts
constructor(id: string, sourceNodeId: string, targetNodeId: string, type: "link", label?: string | null)
```

Creates a new edge.

**Throws**

- `JsMindError` If any of the required parameters are invalid.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | The unique identifier of the edge. |
| `sourceNodeId` | string | The ID of the source node. |
| `targetNodeId` | string | The ID of the target node. |
| `type` | "link" | The type of the edge. |
| `label` (optional) | string \| null | Optional label for the edge. |

### style {#JmEdge.style}

```ts

```

Visual style of the edge line.

**Remarks**

Uses the same `JmLineStyle` as `JmNodeStyle.incoming` so that
hierarchical and additional relationships share one vocabulary.
